eyebrow: Automate the failover, don't document it
code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# failover-tier1.sh
set -euo pipefail

az postgres flexible-server replica promote \
  --name wrenhaven-orders-db-replica-centralus \
  --resource-group rg-wrenhaven-dr

az afd origin update \
  --resource-group rg-wrenhaven-dr \
  --profile-name wrenhaven-afd \
  --origin-group-name checkout-origins \
  --origin-name checkout-centralus \
  --priority 1

curl -sf https://checkout.wrenhaven.com/health
caption: A script that runs the same way every time, instead of a runbook a tired on-call engineer reads at 3 a.m.
